mapper.select: SELECT * FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_PWD = #{userPwd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APP_USER (USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, USER_AGE, USER_BALANCE) VALUES(#{userId},#{userPwd},#{userName},#{userAge},#{userBalance})
mapper.update: UPDATE APP_USER SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, USER_AGE = #{userAge} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_PWD = #{userPwd}
